name: A late fee never makes a settled liability reopen
title: SC-13-05-15 A late fee never makes a settled liability reopen
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
And unit "A-3" paid its "Eylül 2026" debt in full today
When the clock moves forward 30 days
Then unit "A-3" still owes 0.00 for "Eylül 2026"
